notes.title: Patch Notice on Issue Fix
notes.content:
Hello, this is Sesisoft.

Thank you for your interest and support in The Cloud Dream of the Nine Steam version.

We are carefully referencing the bug reports and points of improvements sent by users immediately after launch for the official launch.

We announce that there's an important issue that users cannot proceed the game and it is now fixed through the patch.

For those who have installed the game before, please end the game and proceed with the "update" in the library.
If the "Update" button does not appear, you can check it by logging out and logging in again.

Thank you.

[Patch Details]

* The issue of not proceeding the scenario after the female character's monologue scene after the dialogue below.
Baeknan - I'll see you later!
Truguy - Ok! See you later!
Wol - I see what happened. Should we go back first?
